name: Gen5W Split Screen Blocker
description: Removes the right-hand split screen, its slide-out tab and its pop-ups from every screen, including over CarPlay and Android Auto. To turn it off: in HMG-API, open Mods, pick Gen5W Split Screen Blocker, switch it off and tap Apply changes. The split screen comes back at the next screen change, even if HMG-API shows Restart needed. To turn it back on: switch it on, tap Apply changes, then tap Restart unit. Runs only on the software builds it was checked on (Ioniq 6 and Kia US 260507); on any other build it changes nothing.
